profiles.biography: Chris Church is a visual adjudicator and a 35-year veteran band director who spent 13 seasons on the marching/visual staff of the World Champion Phantom Regiment drum and bugle corps. He currently serves as a visual judge for Drum Corps International and a winter guard judge for the Mid-Continent Color Guard Association and Winter Guard and Percussion of Oklahoma, and is a graduate of the Marching Roundtable Judges Academy. He also adjudicates concert bands, jazz ensembles, and solo & ensemble festivals across the United States.

profiles.biography: Frank Miller, based in Bradenton, Florida, is a visual artist, clinician, and adjudicator whose involvement in the marching music activity spans over five decades, progressing from student to teacher, designer, and consultant. For over 25 years he has been an accredited adjudicator for Bands of America, Drum Corps International, and Winter Guard International, serving in the Visual Analysis and Ensemble Visual captions at DCI World Championships. His work as a visual design specialist emphasizes individual student training, design quality, and consistency of performance.

facts.fact: 5 decades in marching music; 25+ yrs accredited BOA/DCI/WGI visual judge; Bradenton FL visual design specialist

profiles.biography: Jeff Brooks is a percussion adjudicator and a senior non-commissioned officer in the United States Army Old Guard Fife and Drum Corps, the Army's premier field music ensemble and official escort to the President. A native of Dayton, Ohio, he studied music education at Eastern Michigan and Wright State, and performed in DCI with the Glassmen, Crossmen, Madison Scouts, and Bluecoats and in WGI with Rhythm X (Ensemble Captain for their first World Championship in 2008). As an educator he has worked with Carolina Crown, the Madison Scouts, George Mason University, and many high school programs. He is Judge Coordinator for the Atlantic Indoor Association and a DCI percussion judge, including at the 2025 DCI World Championships.

facts.fact: US Army Old Guard Fife & Drum Corps NCO; DCI performer (Glassmen/Crossmen/Madison/Bluecoats); Rhythm X 2008 champ; Atlantic Indoor Assoc Judge Coordinator; DCI percussion judge

profiles.biography: Troy Hall is a percussion, general-effect, and ensemble-music adjudicator for Drum Corps International who performed as a snare drummer with the Phantom Regiment and the undefeated 1994 DCI World Champion Blue Devils (winner of the Fred Sanford High Percussion Award), and has instructed the Colts and Phantom Regiment. He holds a Ph.D. in Philosophy from the University of Missouri, where he teaches drumset and jazz masterclasses as well as ethics and logic courses, and has presented percussion and jazz masterclasses at universities nationwide.

facts.fact: PhD Philosophy (Univ. of Missouri); 1994 champion Blue Devils snare; Colts/Phantom Regiment instructor; DCI percussion/GE judge

profiles.biography: Marie Grana-Czapinski is a Hall of Fame visual adjudicator and a co-founder of Winter Guard International, widely regarded as one of the most accomplished judges in the marching arts. She began as a member of the Norwood Park Imperials in Chicago and became an instructor at 18, received her first DCI judging assignment in 1971, and has been a regular on DCI World Championship and regional panels ever since, including seven years as DCI visual caption head. She succeeded her mentor Don Angelica as WGI's chief judge in 1980, is one of only a small handful qualified to judge every DCI visual caption, and is the only person inducted into the Halls of Fame of all three of WGI, DCI, and Bands of America.

profiles.biography: Mike Rubino is a brass/music adjudicator and retired music educator who directed the Live Oak High School marching band in Morgan Hill, California, to the championship of the first Marching Bands of America National Championship in 1976 and two national titles overall, retiring after 33 years in the Morgan Hill Unified School District. He has been the Drum Corps International Pacific region judges' coordinator since 1995 and serves as an adjudicator for Bands of America and DCI, including as Chief Judge for the Drum Corps at the Rose Bowl (2022) and DCI West (2023), judging across the nation and in Japan.

facts.fact: Led Live Oak HS to 1976 MBA National Championship; 33-yr educator; DCI Pacific region judges coordinator since 1995; chief judge Rose Bowl/DCI West
